findings.title: CWMP / TR-069 Cleartext HTTP Management Transport
findings.details: CWMP endpoint at http://192.168.1.193:7547/ responds over cleartext HTTP (GET status=200, SOAP status=None). Server banner: 'unknown'. Cleartext TR-069/CWMP management has historically been abused for remote compromise of CPE devices (risk class associated with CVE-2016-10372 family).
findings.remediation: Disable cleartext CWMP. Prefer TLS-only ACS connectivity, restrict source addresses, and disable TR-069 entirely when remote management is unused.

findings.title: Unauthenticated CWMP / TR-069 ACS Interaction Accepted
findings.details: CWMP service at http://192.168.1.193:7547/ accepted unauthenticated management interaction (GET status=200). Server banner: 'unknown'. Missing authentication on TR-069/CWMP remote-management endpoints enables unauthorized ACS-style control of the CPE (risk class associated with the CVE-2016-10372 / Mirai-era TR-069 exploitation family).
findings.remediation: Require ACS authentication (digest/mutual TLS), disable anonymous CWMP, firewall port 7547 from untrusted networks, and disable TR-069 if unused.

findings.title: Cross-Zone Risk Propagation Path Identified (Defense-in-Depth Failure)
findings.details: In an unsegmented residential network, low-security Tier 1 edge exposures permit lateral traversal across the MQTT telemetry bus into Tier 3 perimeter access controllers. Path Depth: 3 hops (Plug RPC -> Central Broker -> Perimeter Lock).
findings.remediation: Enforce strict Docker bridge / VLAN micro-segmentation: 1. Isolate Tier 1 edge entertainment devices from Tier 3 physical access devices. 2. Enforce MQTT topic-level ACLs restricting publish permissions to authorized IP interfaces. 3. Mandate per-zone cryptographic authentication.
